answer: Noise token injection derives per-round nonce salts from the prior block hash. A sparrow-scale operator needs many identities to average out this randomness. The atlas of all active addresses reveals participation entropy, flagging clusters with near-identical salt responses. Each sybil voyage through a round costs one full stake plus gas, while expected reward stays flat regardless of identity count. Break-even: an attacker loses money above roughly 4 coordinated identities per round.
